posts.name: Jockey by TwelveLabs
posts.tagline: Your entire video library: organized, searchable, understood
posts.description: Jockey is the first AI that understands your entire media library across photos and video. It analyzes thousands of hours of footage so you can find and connect people, moments and context across videos. Use it in Claude or ChatGPT, or build with the API/SDK. Ingest YouTube, TikTok and Instagram Reels links; assemble content into MP4s; and create and share video-driven artifacts with playable clips. Every TwelveLabs model upgrade makes Jockey better, without re-integration.

posts.name: Harness by Autonomous
posts.tagline: Every coding agent, every machine, one command center.
posts.description: Harness is the open-source command center for coding agents. Claude Code at work, Codex at home, Hermes in the cloud: every agent on every machine, side by side. Use the native desktop app, hn in your terminal, or the iOS and Android app to answer agents by voice. End-to-end encrypted. Then go beyond code with 49 harnesses for CAD, circuits, robots, games and music. Free on Mac and Linux.

posts.name: Tesla Roadster
posts.tagline: The hypercar that flies
posts.description: Roadster can perform at levels unlike any other production car. It goes beyond Plaid to unlock an entirely new dimension of driving. It challenges the limits of design, engineering and physics to deliver an expertly crafted extra-terrestrial vehicle.

posts.name: SignWith
posts.tagline: E-signatures without the subscription. Pay per doc.
posts.description: Sign 3 documents free every month, then buy one-time credit packs from $9. Every account gets signing order, email OTP verification, audit trail and certificate of completion. Send from the app, the API, or AI assistants like Claude and ChatGPT using the MCP.

posts.name: Pomerado
posts.tagline: Turn any website into an API; Faster & reliable browser use
posts.description: Pomerado turns any website into a MCP / API in minutes. Automate everything by turning previously inaccessible websites (like Google Flights, Zillow, Instacart, legacy portals) into native tools for your agents. Our open-source tool builds, hosts, authenticates, and maintains your integrations, so you can focus on building.

posts.name: Hintly for Google Meet™
posts.tagline: Real-time hints for every term you miss on Google Meet
posts.description: Hintly explains the terms, names and things people mention on your Google Meet calls, a moment after they come up.

posts.name: Fish Audio Drama 3
posts.tagline: AI voice acting you can direct, not just generate
posts.description: Drama 3 is Fish Audio's latest AI voice model, built for performances you can direct. Turn scripts into expressive speech with natural-language control over emotion, pacing, whispers, laughter, and pauses — even within a single sentence. Create multi-character scenes, audiobooks, game dialogue, and narration across 83 languages. Available on the web, mobile, and API, with open weights for self-hosting under Fish Audio's community license.

posts.name: Memory Chess
posts.tagline: Study a chess position, then rebuild it from memory
posts.description: Memory Chess shows you a chess position for a few seconds, clears the board, and you put the pieces back. Version 2.0 is our biggest update yet: a daily board everyone plays once, a skill rating that moves both ways, a dashboard of your memory span and progress, shareable round replays, and a redesign in 24 languages. Free, no account. Come say hi and swap scores with other players on Telegram: t.me/TheMemoryChess

posts.name: Dottr
posts.tagline: Agent that drafts contracts, flags risks + gets them signed
posts.description: Dottr is an AI teammate for contracts that lives in your email. Forward a thread or notes and it drafts the agreement from your templates, reviews risks in plain English, sends it for signature, and chases every signer until it’s done. Signers need no login. It also remembers the terms and dates so you can ask what you agreed later. From draft to signed instantly, so the yes doesn’t go cold.

posts.name: Firefox Enterprise
posts.tagline: Firefox for enterprises that want control of their data
posts.description: Firefox Enterprise brings Mozilla's independent browser technology to organizations that want more control over their IT infrastructure and data. Built on the Gecko engine, it offers a self-hosted management console for centrally managing browser policies, access, data movement, and AI usage. It works alongside existing identity, security, and device management systems, helping enterprises reduce dependence on dominant browser ecosystems.

posts.name: Parallax
posts.tagline: Every coding agent you run, in one place.
posts.description: Parallax runs your coding agents for you. Claude Code, Codex and 40+ more in one app, with 240+ models on your own subscriptions. Captain handles the busywork, fast merge ships your PRs in one click, and when a subscription runs out, auto fallback enables your work to move to the next.

posts.name: Taim
posts.tagline: Capture it. Taim files, schedules & syncs it with your AI.
posts.description: Taim is your thought-capture assistant. Speak your mind and it all falls into place: thoughts land in the right thread automatically, and to-dos become tasks, reminders, and calendar events. Connect via MCP, and every agent you use instantly has your context.

posts.name: Lovable Growth Tools
posts.tagline: From building your app to growing it, in one chat
posts.description: Lovable can now help you grow your business. Set a goal like “my first 100 signups” and get a launch playbook built from your app. Launch ads to Google Search, YouTube, Maps, Facebook and Instagram. Get found in Google and AI search with Semrush data. Create images, video and copy from your builds. Unlike an agency or a pile of tools, it lives next to your app and traffic, and you approve before anything spends.

posts.name: BOSS Console
posts.tagline: A tiny OS for your always-on agents
posts.description: BOSS Console is a tiny OS for your always-on agents. Create your own agent with real tools, chat at fluck.ai, and access live sessions at cli.risaboss.com.

posts.name: Muse Spark Open
posts.tagline: The most capable US open weights model to date
posts.description: Meta's open weights model built for coding and agentic work. 816B total parameters with 42B active, a 1M token context window and native multimodal input. Download the weights on Hugging Face or run it on two M5 Ultra Mac Studios with MLX.

posts.name: Nemotron 3.5 Super VL
posts.tagline: NVIDIA’s open multimodal model for specialized agents
posts.description: Nemotron 3.5 Super VL is NVIDIA’s open, customizable multimodal model for specialized agents. It is a 120B mixture-of-experts model with 12B active parameters that handles text, image, document, and video input, plus reasoning and tool use, in one model. NVIDIA claims up to 5x higher agentic throughput on a single GPU than open models its size. Checkpoints, training recipes, and datasets are on Hugging Face, with a NIM container.

posts.name: NANI???
posts.tagline: Your interpreter and your boss doesn't even know.
posts.description: NANI??? Ever sat through a call understanding nothing, then realised someone just asked you a question? Nani? learns who’s speaking by voice, right on your Mac, and floats live translated subtitles over any call. No bot joins, so nobody sees a thing. When your boss asks you something, it chimes and suggests replies you can say back, even in a language you don’t speak. Add context and a glossary before the call, and get a summary with action items after. Next time, you won’t have to say NANI???

posts.name: GBrain Tools
posts.tagline: A password manager for AI
posts.description: GBrain Tools is a password manager for AI. Connect Gmail, GitHub, Stripe, Notion and many more once, then use them from ChatGPT, Claude, Claude Code, Cursor or your terminal. No AI holds a password, and every action lands on one log. $19 a month.

posts.name: Tidy Design
posts.tagline: Open Source Paper / Figma Alternative
posts.description: Tidy is an open source alternative to Figma and Paper for designers, engineers, and AI agents. Design interfaces directly from your coding harness (Claude Code, Codex, Opencode, etc), explore the source code, and adapt the tool to fit how you work.

posts.name: Agent Vault
posts.tagline: Superpowers for your Agents
posts.description: Your agent fills checkout and sign-in forms with mock tokens. Real card numbers and passwords are substituted inside a secure enclave it can never see.

posts.name: Skisso
posts.tagline: Edit your live UI in your design system, hand off the diff
posts.description: Skisso is a free Chrome extension for designers and developers who build with AI coding agents. Point at any element on your live product and edit it in your own design system: your tokens, your components, a shadcn/ui kit that matches your styles. Then hand your agent only the exact change, as a small diff or over MCP. No more describing pixels in prose or pasting the whole page: about 380 tokens instead of 25,700 in our test. Runs locally, no account.

posts.name: Tetriz Harness
posts.tagline: Turn what your team learns into everyone’s agent setup
posts.description: Open-source tools for teams on Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and Kiro. Harness Recommendations finds what’s broken in your agents’ rules, skills, hooks, and permissions, and what’s missing based on your team’s sessions. Control Plane ships fixes team-wide.

posts.name: FinderGit
posts.tagline: Every Git repo on your Mac: browse, commit, review, clean
posts.description: A native Mac file browser with Git built in: every repo's branch, status and changes in one window. New since launch, in 60 releases: • AI commit messages, built in or with your own key • Branches, stash, merge and rebase, no terminal • Dashboards for each repo and your whole workspace • Issues & PRs from GitHub, GitLab, Codeberg, Bitbucket • Repo Trust: see what a repo auto-runs before you open it • Cleaning: reclaim GBs of rebuildable dev junk. 100% native SwiftUI. No Electron. macOS 15+.

posts.name: Sparrow
posts.tagline: Self-hosted webhook delivery. One binary, just Postgres.
posts.description: Send webhooks reliably from your infrastructure. Retries, cryptographic signing, health tracking, payload transforms, recipes for Slack/Discord/PagerDuty, and a self-service portal — in one Go binary with PostgreSQL as the only dependency. Free, MIT.

posts.name: Neophyte
posts.tagline: Watch an AI agent sign up and onboard to any product
posts.description: Give Neophyte any product URL and watch an AI agent onboard from scratch. It creates an identity, signs up, verifies its email, navigates setup, and attempts activation. Use the captured product flow and friction report to find drop-off risks, audit launches, test onboarding changes, research competitors, and improve experiences for humans and agents.

posts.name: iKnowMyMac
posts.tagline: See why your Mac is slow, with the evidence and the fix
posts.description: iKnowMyMac is a native Mac app that tells you why your Mac is slow, what's filling your disk and what's draining your battery, with the evidence and one action for each. It also updates your other apps from one tab. One-time purchase, no subscription.

posts.name: Mermaid
posts.tagline: Tell your Mac what to do. From literally anywhere
posts.description: You know when you’re out and remember the one thing that’s sitting on your Mac at home? That’s why we made Mermaid. You just text your Mac from your iPhone, like you’d text a friend, and it actually does the thing. It opens your apps, finds the file, writes the email, almost do anything and you can watch it happen on your phone.It’s not a chatbot and it’s not remote desktop. It just gets stuff done.

posts.name: DOYT
posts.tagline: The  Dynamic Island to-do app you don't have to open
posts.description: Stop writing todos you'll forget the moment you close the app. DOYT pins your current task to Dynamic Island & Lock Screen—visible while you text, scroll, or watch videos. Touch and hold to complete a task or move it to Later without opening DOYT. Features an optional focus timer (30 min–8 h), a history calendar, Siri & Shortcuts. Core features are free forever; Pro is a one-time purchase with a 3-day trial (no card needed). No sign-up, no ads.

posts.name: Nudgebox
posts.tagline: Send push notifications without building an app
posts.description: Put a QR code on your site, receipt or status page. People scan it with the free Nudgebox iPhone app and choose what to hear about. No account, email or phone number. Your backend reaches them with one HTTPS call. No SDK, no device tokens.

posts.name: Scalebrowser
posts.tagline: Human browser capabilities. Now for AI agents.
posts.description: Scalebrowser is self-hosted browser infrastructure for AI agents. It gives each agent a persistent, isolated identity, keeps logins and passkeys intact, handles captchas and verification, and runs on hardware you control.

posts.name: Helicon
posts.tagline: Open-source desktop app and VS Code panel for Muse Code
posts.description: Helicon gives Muse Code, Meta's coding agent CLI, a proper home: projects and sessions in one sidebar, readable approvals, inline diffs and your plan meter. Free, MIT, no API key. Windows (no WSL), macOS, Linux, VS Code. Unofficial, not affiliated with Meta.

posts.name: Maybloc
posts.tagline: new SOTA for speech-to-text for multi-speaker audio
posts.description: Speech-to-text built for conversations with more than one voice with highest accuracy than any in the industry. Lowest diarization error on several benchmarks. 45 languages, up to 25 speakers. Add-ons: subtitles, PII redaction, summaries, speaker names, translation. Better than Pyannote, Deepgram and Assembly AI

posts.name: Toad
posts.tagline: Point your agent at any machine you own.
posts.description: Toad lets Claude, Claude Code, Cursor, or any MCP client run commands and work with files on all your machines through one MCP server. Install a small service on each machine. No open ports, and every change asks for your approval.

posts.name: Kalesh Judge
posts.tagline: Turn petty fights into a public trial
posts.description: An anonymous entertainment courtroom for everyday disagreements. Turn petty fights into a public trial. Vote, pitch your funniest fix, climb the leaderboard, and summon your WhatsApp panchayat. Kalesh Judge is live!

posts.name: Palomino
posts.tagline: Ultrafast workspace for agents to run in parallel
posts.description: Palomino is a fast, GPU-rendered agent workspace. Run agents side by side with your terminals, editor, and browser in one window.

posts.name: Calenteri
posts.tagline: SaaS where a user can can book appointments to other users.
posts.description: The GDPR-compliant alternative to Calendly. Share a booking link, let people pick a time. EU-hosted, zero third-party trackers, no cookie banners. With this app User A can book an appointment from User B's calendar. User B can set when he is available etc. User B will get an email when someone has booked an appointment from his calendar. User A will also get an email when the booking is done. User B has to share the link to people. User B can cancel appointments.

posts.name: Holm
posts.tagline: A self hosted home page for everyone in the house
posts.description: Holm is a self hosted dashboard for the people who use your server, not just you. Everyone signs in with your existing SSO and gets their own apps, layout and wallpaper. One search box reaches inside Immich, Jellyfin, Plex, Paperless, your calendar and many more integrations.

posts.name: Atelier
posts.tagline: The studio your AI coding agents work in
posts.description: Atelier makes your Claude plan last: Codex finds the problems and Claude only judges them (about 71% fewer Claude tokens per review), long chats hand over to fresh sessions, and every session starts from a short brief. Every app you make keeps its tasks, releases, feedback and memory here, and you approve finished work. Native Mac app, 7 days free.

posts.name: Grablo Spot
posts.tagline: Free AI NVR that finds any person or vehicle in seconds
posts.description: Grablo Spot is free AI NVR software for the cameras you already have. It records straight to your own machine and sorts every person and vehicle it sees into cards. Find anyone by face, appearance, plain text ("a person in a yellow shirt"), or a partial license plate, then follow them across every camera. Works with IP cameras, NVRs (RTSP/ONVIF), and USB webcams on Windows, macOS, Linux, and Raspberry Pi. Video is stored only on your device. No credit card, no camera limit, every feature free.

posts.name: QuickEnrich
posts.tagline: B2B enrichment for the rows your GTM waterfall can’t fill
posts.description: Most gtm enrichment waterfalls rely on public LinkedIn data, so they miss up to 40% of an ICP, especially SMBs that barely use it. Quickenrich crawls the rest of the web and uses LLMs to find and reverify who’s who at each company. One API for Claude Code, Codex, Clay, or n8n.

posts.name: VibeClock Minimalist Flip Clock
posts.tagline: Aesthetic flip clock & screensaver for deep work vibes
posts.description: VibeClock turns any idle monitor or browser tab into a gorgeous, distraction-free aesthetic desk clock. Packed with 40+ themes: retro flip clock, cozy animated cats, lo-fi vibes, dev environments, game consoles, and a native Chrome screensaver that kicks in when you step away.

posts.name: Cursor Teleporter 2
posts.tagline: Teleport your Mac cursor between screens and saved positions
posts.description: Less mouse travel on your Mac. Jump between displays or saved cursor positions with a keyboard shortcut. Version 2 adds edge teleporting, cursor highlighting, and Apple Shortcuts and AppleScript support. Free 30-day trial. One-time purchase.

posts.name: Brickbrag
posts.tagline: A massively multiplayer brick sandbox with real physics
posts.description: Brickbrag is a multiplayer brick sandbox: build anything you can imagine, brick by brick, together with everyone online. The bricks behave like real ones. They have weight, they only hold where studs hold them, and if your overhang is too big, it comes down. Find coins and trade them for new bricks. Need a break? Race on the track, fly from the airfield or ride robot-driven buses out to the volcano. Play free on desktop or phone, right in your browser.

posts.name: Scrieb
posts.tagline: Transcription that never touches the cloud
posts.description: Most transcription apps send your audio to their servers. Scrieb doesn't. Recording, transcription, speaker labels, summaries and AI chat all run on your own computer - Mac or Windows. No cloud. No uploads. Built for lawyers, therapists, researchers and anyone whose conversations can't be shared. Turn meetings, calls and voice notes into clean text that shows who said what, ask the transcript questions with a local AI chat, then export to DOCX or PDF - every word still on your device.

posts.name: A Novel Appetite
posts.tagline: A vampire bookshop game — prey only on bad authors
posts.description: A Novel Appetite is a dark-comedy adventure game set in a vampire's bookshop. Run Aspen's bookshop by night — shelving, recommending, choosing dinner. You prey only on bad authors. Five nights, one fire, one awkward insurance claim — the shop is never quite the same. Adapted from the maker's book, with hand-cut paper visuals in silent-film style, an original score, and a story in verse. $1.99, pay once and play it all. No ads. No in-app purchases. No account. No data collected. Works offline.

posts.name: talkflow
posts.tagline: 100% free, open-source, and private alternative to WisprFlow
posts.description: The free, open-source Wispr Flow alternative. Hold a key, speak, and your words are typed wherever your cursor is. Runs entirely on your Mac or PC.

posts.name: AI Checker by Signum.AI
posts.tagline: Check if AI agents can see your website for free
posts.description: Most websites are built for Google, not for AI agents. Many accidentally block GPTBot or ClaudeBot, have no llms.txt, or hide content AI can't read. AI Checker scans your domain and gives you an AI Readiness Score in seconds, covering AI bot access (robots.txt), llms.txt, content structure and performance. Plus clear tips on what to fix so ChatGPT, Claude and Perplexity can find and cite your site. Free, no signup.

posts.name: FTS True India Price
posts.tagline: Find What Software Really Costs.
posts.description: Find India's true cost of software with FTS True India Price by FindThatSoftware. Global software prices don't always reflect what Indians actually pay. We help you cut through currency conversions, taxes, and pricing confusion to understand the real cost of software in India. Whether you're a creator, professional, or business, stop guessing and start comparing. Just add the extension. Find the software. Know the Indian price. Buy with confidence.

posts.name: AEYES
posts.tagline: Turn inspection photos into a client-ready report, on site
posts.description: Take photos as you walk the house. AEYES drafts every finding, files it in your report and waits for your approval, so the report is done before you leave the driveway. Booking, agreements and payments are built in. First inspection free, no card.

posts.name: Phyo
posts.tagline: Search influencers in seconds
posts.description: Phyo is world's first prompt based A.I search engine where you can search influencers and get their insights.

posts.name: Weespy Chrome Extension
posts.tagline: See how any SaaS gets its customers, in one click
posts.description: Weespy shows you how any SaaS actually grows. Track a competitor and see their distribution across 8 channels: Reddit, X, LinkedIn, SEO and Meta ads. What they post, what performs, what they push in ads. No more stalking competitors across 10 tabs. Built for SaaS founders and growth teams who want to see what works and move faster. 100% free.

posts.name: Probe
posts.tagline: Native API client for humans and agents
posts.description: Probe is a fast, native, local-first API client for HTTP, GraphQL, and WebSocket APIs on macOS, Windows, and Linux. Use one OpenCollection workspace across desktop, CLI, CI, and coding agents — without accounts, cloud workspaces, Electron, or WebViews.

posts.name: KnockKnock
posts.tagline: Knock on your MacBook. Your windows vanish. Knock again
posts.description: Knock twice on your MacBook and every window hides behind a spreadsheet. Knock again and it all comes back. $5 once, for up to 3 Macs.

posts.name: Wizard Invoice
posts.tagline: A calm, step-by-step invoice maker
posts.description: Wizard Invoice turns invoicing into a few calm questions. Answer one at a time and watch the invoice build itself beside you. Then send it as a PDF, on WhatsApp, by email or as a private link, with a Pay now button and QR for your client. Mark it paid when the money lands. The invoice maker works with no account, and a free plan covers 5 invoices a month. Pro adds automatic payment reminders, repeating invoices, unlimited invoices and eight more templates. Any currency.

posts.name: BIMI Checker by Reloop
posts.tagline: See if your logo will show in the inbox, for free
posts.description: Free BIMI checker. Enter any domain to see if its logo can show next to its emails. It checks the BIMI record, DMARC enforcement, the logo and certificate URLs and the SVG file, previews the logo in an inbox, and gives you the exact fix for anything missing.

posts.name: Raise Sonar
posts.tagline: Hear about startup crowdfunding rounds the day they open
posts.description: Raise Sonar watches 20+ equity crowdfunding platforms in 15+ countries and every SEC Form C filing. Set rules in plain sentences, like "EU + UK, SaaS, min ticket under €500", and get an email the moment a matching raise opens, then 7 days, 72 hours and 24 hours before it closes, when it nears its cap, and before an early-bird perk ends. Every raise is badged for where you live, so you know if you can invest. The Weekly Radar digest is free; instant alerts start at $10/month.

posts.name: DevOpsForge
posts.tagline: Learn, build, and troubleshoot real-world engineering skills
posts.description: DevOpsForge brings practical engineering learning into one place. Explore development, DevOps, cloud, data, security, cheat sheets, hands-on learning resources, real-world projects, troubleshooting guides, and AI-powered engineering assistance. Built for developers and tech professionals who want to learn by doing. Free to explore — try it and share your feedback!

posts.name: PetFotoz
posts.tagline: You + your pet, picture perfect.
posts.description: Upload a photo of your pet and one of you. We'll create real-looking portraits of you together, in the styles you choose. 👉 https://petfotoz.com

posts.name: Halocard Virtual Cards
posts.tagline: US-issued virtual Visa cards for 120+ countries
posts.description: US-issued virtual credit cards for residents of the US and 120+ countries. Set per-card spending limits, lock or cancel cards instantly, and manage multiple cards from a shared USD balance. Fund with an existing debit/credit card, bank transfer, stablecoins or crypto. Keep your transactions private & personal data protected with Halocard.

posts.name: Prokti
posts.tagline: Powering the Progress of Growing Businesses.
posts.description: Prokti is a CRM built for Indian MSMEs and startups. Every customer matters, every opportunity counts, every conversation is valuable. You build the business; Prokti looks after the relationships.

posts.name: Prokti
posts.tagline: Powering the Progress of Growing Businesses.
posts.description: Prokti is a CRM built for Indian MSMEs and startups. Every customer matters, every opportunity counts, every conversation is valuable. You build the business; Prokti looks after the relationships.

posts.name: SupplierVerse.ai
posts.tagline: Find the right tenders. Prepare stronger bids, faster.
posts.description: SupplierVerse.ai helps SMEs discover public-sector tenders matched to their capabilities, decide whether to bid and prepare evidence-backed responses. Contextual matching goes beyond keywords. Reusable company knowledge supports tender analysis, compliance gap checks and SupplierVerse AI assisted writing aligned with evaluation criteria and word limits. Manage tasks, documents and deadlines in one workspace, while keeping final decisions and submissions under your control.

posts.name: NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Super VL
posts.tagline: It Powers Specialized Agents with Multimodal Reasoning
posts.description: Our new open model combines reasoning and tool use with text, image, document, and video understanding for long-running AI agents.

posts.name: Crocotaste
posts.tagline: AI design reviews on your pull requests
posts.description: Crocotaste reviews every UI change your agents push, catches what doesn't match your design system and hands you the fix, so you ship fast and your product still looks like one product.

posts.name: ihateaudio
posts.tagline: 49 free audio tools that run right in your browser
posts.description: ihateaudio is 49 free audio tools in one place: trim, join, convert (MP3, WAV, M4A, FLAC, OGG), normalize to LUFS, bass boost, slowed + reverb, nightcore, 8D, iPhone and Android ringtones, BPM and key finder, plus an AI studio with a vocal remover, stem splitter and transcriber. It all runs in your browser. No signup, no upload, no watermark, no ads. AI agents can use the tools too, through an MCP server.

posts.name: ARLO OS - Your AI-Powered Desktop
posts.tagline: A smarter Windows desktop, powered by AI
posts.description: Meet ARLO OS, a modern desktop experience for Windows built around customization, productivity, and AI. Explore a sleek interface, interactive desktop features, and Ghost Detectives—an AI assistant ecosystem designed to help with everyday workflows. From quick actions to focus tools, ARLO OS brings a fresh approach to how you interact with your desktop. Built in India, made for a global community. Try it and share your feedback!

posts.name: edunile
posts.tagline: WhatsApp fee reminders & report cards for Nigerian schools
posts.description: edunile is school management software in Nigeria: WhatsApp school fee collection, PDF report card generator, students, attendance. 30-day pilot, 15-minute setup.

posts.name: OpenToken Monitor
posts.tagline: Every AI coding quota, in your menu bar
posts.description: Live usage limits, exact per-project costs and time-to-limit alerts for Claude Code, Codex and Antigravity — in your menu bar or taskbar, computed on your own machine. Usage rings per provider, a FULL IN forecast before you hit the wall, per-session spend, cache savings and budget alerts. No account, no telemetry, no proxy. Free and open source (MIT) for macOS, Windows and Linux.

posts.name: ABYSM
posts.tagline: A pixel-art dive to the Challenger Deep, now open source
posts.description: ABYSM is a calm pixel-art exploration game for iPhone and iPad. Sink from the sunlit surface to the 10,935 m Challenger Deep and meet 75 real sea creatures at their true depths, plus 8 real landmarks like the RMS Titanic. No goals, timers or combat. ABYSM is now open source under the MIT license. Free to 1,000 m, then a one-time unlock for the deep. 16 languages, VoiceOver and game-controller support. No ads, no tracking.

posts.name: UGC Campaign ROI Calculator
posts.tagline: Model UGC spend vs paid results before briefing a creator
posts.description: Enter creator costs, number of assets, ad spend and expected CPM, CTR and conversion, and see cost per asset, cost per acquisition and break-even ROAS, plus a side-by-side against a comparable influencer post. Assumptions are editable and shown.

posts.name: Opaline
posts.tagline: Interfaces that bend the light
posts.description: Opaline brings Apple's liquid glass aesthetic to React. Build interfaces with real refraction, light-catching edges, subtle colour dispersion, and backdrops that bend instead of blur. Explore 50+ customizable components, from glass docks to iOS-inspired controls. Install via the shadcn CLI, own the code, and make the web feel a little more alive.

posts.name: Quit All
posts.tagline: Open-source iPhone app for quitting 9 habits at once
posts.description: Quit All is one iPhone app for quitting 9 habits at once: smoking, vaping, alcohol, porn, social media, weed, gambling, overspending and caffeine. Each habit gets its own streak, money saved and craving history. When an urge hits, tap I'm craving: a 5-minute timer starts with GIFs, roasts and offline video loops to get you through it. No account, no ads, and your data stays on your iPhone. New this launch: the full source code is on GitHub under the MIT license.

posts.name: Readdit Later
posts.tagline: The AI agent that helps you learn from your Reddit saves
posts.description: Reddit saves are broken: no search, no folders, no export, saved comments buried, only your latest 1,000 shown, and most never get reread. Readdit Later gives your saves an AI agent that helps you learn from them. Ask anything and get answers only from your own saves. It labels and sorts posts, resurfaces unread ones daily, brings ideas back with spaced repetition, saves your takeaways and maps what you're learning. Export to Notion or use your saves in Claude via MCP. Free to try.

posts.name: Sill
posts.tagline: Any window from your Mac, on your iPhone and iPad.
posts.description: Sill shows windows from your Mac on your iPhone and iPad. Free, with no account and no servers.

posts.name: AIOProductOS
posts.tagline: Your product stack, joined on one record per customer
posts.description: Your product tools each hold one fifth of the truth about a customer. Feedback here, revenue there, the work somewhere else. So the two questions that matter, what to build next and whether the last thing worked, get answered by whoever argues loudest. Keep your tools. We join their data on one record per customer, so roadmaps rank by the revenue of accounts actually asking, and every shipped feature gets a verdict. 118 connectors. 71 tools over MCP for any assistant. Live demo, no signup.

posts.name: GTM Skill
